source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Types of Computer Networks' (PDF 8): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Computer networks ko un ke size aur coverage area (network kitne ilaqe tak phaila hai) ki bunyad par classify (qismon mein baanta) kiya jata hai. Mukhtalif qism ke networks mukhtalif kaamon ke liye istemal hote hain. Har qism devices ko apne khaas tareeqe se jorti hai. Sab se aam qismein LAN, WAN aur Internet (Public WAN) hain. Yeh networks baat-cheet aur data share karne mein madad dete hain. Network ki qismein samajhne se sahi network chunne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Computer networks ko faasle (distance) aur coverage area ki bunyad par qismon mein baanta jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Computer networks ko kis bunyad par qismon mein baanta jata hai, aur teen aam qismein kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation: Size aur coverage area (faasle) ki bunyad par. Teen aam qismein: LAN, WAN aur Internet (Public WAN).

items: Networks size aur coverage area ke hisaab se: LAN, WAN, Internet (Public WAN).
